# 7437 - Quadruple 2-input NAND buffer

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7437.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7437.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 10 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7437 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7437.png) | ![7437 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand-buf2.png) | ![7437 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand-buf2.png) |

An empty box whose right side is a point (pentagon).

How to tell it on a drawing: Empty + pointed end = NAND buffer.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |

| 4 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 5 | 2B | input |  |  |
| 6 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | 3Y | output | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = NOT(1A AND 1B) | 1Y is the NAND of 1A, 1B. |
| 6 | 2Y = NOT(2A AND 2B) | 2Y is the NAND of 2A, 2B. |
| 8 | 3Y = NOT(3A AND 3B) | 3Y is the NAND of 3A, 3B. |
| 11 | 4Y = NOT(4A AND 4B) | 4Y is the NAND of 4A, 4B. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1.2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Buffer: IOL 48 mA vs 16 mA for 7400 and IOH -1.2 mA vs -0.4 mA: can drive three times as many inputs or a long line. IOS -18 to -70 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 ohm, CL 45 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN5437/SN7437/SN74LS37/SN74S37 datasheet SDLS103](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls37.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7437
